posts.en:
dsh-research is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Curated research plugin market: adds a Research plugins page to Settings with hand-reviewed plugins for literature search, reference management, writing and workbenches — one-click install, update and remove pinned to the reviewed version, restart from the panel, and exactly one network request (its own catalog).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-eac1046933d9372fe911.html
